gloss: to be consistent; to be coherent throughout

definitions.gloss: to be consistent; to be coherent throughout; to remain unchanged
definitions.explanation: For a position, attitude, policy, or quality to remain the same from beginning to end without contradiction. Often used approvingly to describe someone who holds firm to their principles.

examples.japanese: {態度|たいど}が{一貫|いっかん}している。
{彼|かれ}の{主張|しゅちょう}は{最初|さいしょ}から{一貫|いっかん}している。
examples.english: His argument has been consistent from the start.

examples.japanese: {一貫|いっかん}した{方針|ほうしん}のもとで{事業|じぎょう}を{進|すす}めてきた。
examples.english: We have advanced the business under a consistent policy.

examples.japanese: {設計|せっけい}から{製造|せいぞう}まで{一貫|いっかん}して{自社|じしゃ}で{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: We handle the entire process in-house, from design through manufacturing.

notes:
Composed of {一|いち} (one) and {貫|かん} (pierce, penetrate). Literally 'to pierce through as one,' conveying the image of a single thread running through something from start to finish. Often used as the adverb {一貫|いっかん}して (consistently, throughout).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {態度|たいど}が{一貫|いっかん}している: one's attitude is consistent
- {主張|しゅちょう}が{一貫|いっかん}している: one's argument is consistent
- {一貫|いっかん}した{方針|ほうしん}: a consistent policy
- {一貫|いっかん}して: consistently, throughout
- {一貫|いっかん}{生産|せいさん}: integrated production

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {首尾|しゅび}{一貫|いっかん}: consistency from beginning to end — four-character compound emphasizing logical coherence
- {継続|けいぞく}する: to continue — focuses on duration rather than unchanging quality
- {徹底|てってい}する: to be thorough — emphasizes completeness rather than consistency over time
